status.detail: Anthropic's filing is reported public; the Oct 31 item is market context, not IPO news.

editorial.take_for_builders: Read the S-1's cloud-partner and compute-commitment sections before locking multi-year Anthropic spend, and keep a fallback provider for any lab whose IPO terms are unsettled.
editorial.tldr: 10월 15일 Anthropic은 자체 상장을 앞두고 분기 매출이 50% 가까이 늘어 $16.8bn에 이르렀다고 투자자들에게 밝혔습니다. 10월 27일 Latent Space는 S-1을 정리하며 1400% 성장과 클라우드 파트너를 통한 매출 비중 48%를 짚었습니다.
editorial.whats_new: Oct 31: Latent Space ties Google's AI Mode to a 15% (~$500B) Search-parent drop, the worst since its 2004 IPO, as market context for AI listings.
editorial.why_it_matters: An S-1 gives platform teams audited figures on cloud-partner revenue share and growth, which indicate how dependent a vendor is on hyperscaler channels when you plan multi-provider fallbacks.
